test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

BEING : YVRMT : : PRIDE : KIRWV : : CLEAN : ?
solution:
The position of the alphabet is given as,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65a5ce41837de973f71e1f5365fafd54dff4a1eb865aebca99adff0a4c4606cb.png] 

The pattern followed here is the opposite series i.e.,

__
 
• 1st alphabet → 26th alphabet i.e. A → Z
 
• 2ⁿd alphabet → 25th alphabet i.e. B → Y
 
• 3rd alphabet → 24th alphabet i.e. C → X
 
• And so on till 13th alphabet → 14th alphabet i.e. M → N

**Given:**

**BEING : YVRMT**__ : : PRIDE : KIRWV : : CLEAN : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d94954695c2bfe5056bb2b48abd885491ed3d848a5e28296c6d878474cf5ac70.png] 

BEING : YVRMT : : __**PRIDE : KIRWV**__ : : CLEAN : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79a7531826253305b4b6aa2f6e60173bf2b73b3988c83817783ffe96e92dc3e0.png] 

Similarly,

BEING : YVRMT : : PRIDE : KIRWV : : __**CLEAN : ?**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c81f434e6b93f50bcf1dc09860d0c028d916127d7a1e7c6ad25f8d0457da8a4.png] 

Hence,** the correct answer is "XOVZM".**
